## Body

TIME-BOXED EXCEPTION to role.md's "never type into a pane". Granted by the prime (pij-far-jackal) 2026-11-08 05:05. Valid only until the modal-stall detector (F108) and a fix for the dialog itself land; then this note is void.

You may press ctrl+d, and only ctrl+d, on a seat's pane, when ALL of these hold:
1. The pane shows Copilot's "Follow-up action:" list, with "↑/↓ select · enter accept · ctrl+d decline" as its last lines.
2. The seat's work for that turn is already persisted (the dialog says so, e.g. "The verdict is persisted and reported", or its pij output exists).
3. You capture the pane just before pressing, so the match isn't from scrollback.

Command: tmux send-keys -t <pane> C-d. Never press enter, never choose an option, never type anything else. Report each decline to pm-001 in one line (role:pm-001 --reply none).

Background: herring (security, gpt-6.1-sol) shows this dialog after every verdict (04:11 and 04:46 on 08 Nov), and pij keeps showing it working. The default option, "Fix highest severity issues", must never be chosen for a review seat. Find it with the F47 check: a working seat with no model call for 15 to 30 min.
